items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: Joe Darnsberg? I know. I can't recall him. I know. I know.

ctx.x: Yeah. I knew Joe Darnsberg out in California that plays with Tedore Clarinetist. Do you remember? Was he any member of that family?
Joe Darnsberg? I know. I can't recall him. I know. I know.
And then I was up in Baton Rouge about two years ago. And we interviewed Willie Foster, one of the old-time guitar players. He played guitar, I think, more than he did banjo.
